messages.text: Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

Here's the Thor P2 at the US average, 17 cents a kWh, plus the two step-ups so you can see the spread. It's $369 right now, down from $449.

Thor P2, 10 TH/s at 166 W: about 14,330 sats a month, worth roughly $11.94 today, power about $20.59 a month. Break-even BTC price $143,679. Solo block jackpot $261,906, odds about 0.06% over a year.

Harlo B30, 30 TH/s: ~42,990 sats a month ($35.83), power $50.23, break-even $116,847, 0.17% jackpot odds a year.

Magic Miner 40T, 40 TH/s: ~57,320 sats ($47.78), power $80.62, break-even $140,649, 0.22% odds.

At 17 cents none of these are net profit today, it's sats stacked plus the jackpot shot. Tell me your state and your per-kWh rate and I'll rerun it properly, cheap power changes the picture fast.
